response.sql:
WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
shares AS (
  SELECT zoneref, feature_count,
         feature_count::numeric / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM site_totals
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code,
       s.feature_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS margin_above_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The site code is scanfeatures.zoneref, and the "average share across sites" is the mean of the shares of only the sites that have at least one non-NULL traitcount row. Sites with no feature records are left out of both the totals and the average.
Rows with a NULL traitcount are excluded before summing, so a site whose rows are all NULL does not appear. The overall feature total is the sum of the per-site totals.

alternatives.interpretation: The average is taken across every site in the sites table, so sites with no feature records count as zero. This lowers the average to 1 divided by the number of sites.
alternatives.sql:
WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT st.zoneregistry AS zoneref,
         COALESCE(SUM(f.traitcount), 0) AS feature_count
  FROM sites st
  LEFT JOIN scanfeatures f
    ON f.zoneref = st.zoneregistry AND f.traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY st.zoneregistry
),
shares AS (
  SELECT zoneref, feature_count,
         feature_count::numeric / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM site_totals
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code,
       s.feature_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS margin_above_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
